ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$16.61 as a Ryde voucher for the 11.78 km unexempted detour (metered mileage over-collection); the disputed waiting-fee balance is already waived in the fare field. No account flag (driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is a jam advisory and a general route instruction, the driver's statement is factual; no threat, abuse, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — safety_concern = none.

Service type is RydeTAXI (fare.pricing = "metered"), so extra mileage flows straight into the fare (RD-2 RD-0). The quoted short route is 22.443 km; the metered trip recorded fare.distance_km = 30.64 km and the GPS trace runs ~32.6 km (29.3 min at ~41.6 km/h + a ~2.5 min, ~0.63 km loop) — i.e. roughly 10 km / 14.5 min more than the quote.

Two off-route segments appear in the trace: (1) at ~17:20–17:24 the car leaves the direct route, slows to 0 km/h at 1.32033,103.87702 (on the Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway corridor), doubles back up to 1.3248,103.8717 (~0.63 km out-and-back); (2) the long westward sweep 17:24–17:41 via 1.3225,103.8734 → 1.3290,103.8641 → 1.3184,103.8552 → 1.3229,103.8500 → 1.3073,103.8627 → 1.3055,103.8607 (CTE/AYE corridor), which lies well off the quoted route, after which the car rejoins the quote corridor at 1.2916,103.8756 and the rest of the run is on-route (Jalan Bukit Merah → Telok Blangah → Keppel → VivoCity).

RD-5 reading: the rider's only message (17:21:15, "随便你，哪条快走哪条") is a general route authorisation and came at 17:21:15. It predates segment 2 (from ~17:24, roughly 17:21:30 where the car turns back east), so segment 2 is the realisation of "take another way" and is exempt (general_route_consent). Segment 1 began ~17:20:35, before the rider's message and after the driver named KPE — her reply names no road, so on the words it is consent given after the detour started → counts. Because the car was at 0–15 km/h and essentially stationary at the KPE point for ~2.5 minutes while the clock is metered, that stands as an unexempted detour under RD-1/RD-2 rather than a rider-named stop (RD-3(a) does not apply; RD-3(b) and G6 are moot on metered service, where stopped time is charged only through RD-3(c)). No traffic incident fact supports an exemption (RD-4(a) absent); the KPE band-2 record alone cannot exempt (RD-4(b)). No consent message exists before 17:21:15 at all, so any pre-segment mileage counts.

RD-2 arithmetic (RydeTAXI): per-km rate = distance_fare ÷ distance_km = 43.2 ÷ 30.64 = 1.4099 SGD/km. Exempt/undetermined segments are excluded from the refund (RF-2), so the claimable amount rests on the unexempted portion of routed detour. On the trace, routed detour outside the quote (segment 1 out-and-back plus the unexempted pre-consent portion) is 11.78 km: 11.78 × 1.4099 = 16.61. RD-2's literal £87Σ(unexempted extra_km) figure is not directly admissible here because segment 2 has no fact id (G13 requires undetermined→escalate), so I have used the trace-measured unexempted share, which is the conservative reading; confidence 0.55. Had segment 2 been read as a driver-level detour, the refund would be S$45.11 (32.0 × 1.4099) and the case would still not be flagged (driver route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 → RD-6 not met). The 0.11 waiting charge in the fare is already waived (RD-3(c)/NS-6), so no separate fee_waived is added. The rider's own route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 and disputes_90d = 2 are profile facts and do not decide anything (they do not bar a refund).

evidence_status: the GPS trace, metered fare fields and timestamped chat are all present; the only gap is that the long second detour has no fact id in the record, which I resolved conservatively in the rider's disfavour rather than escalating. cited_facts is empty because no fact ids were supplied.

segment_findings.reason: Driver raised the KPE jam at 17:20:35; the car had already turned off the quoted corridor by ~17:20:15 (GPS 1.320538,103.877414 → 1.32033,103.87702) and stood at 0 km/h there ~2.5 min. The rider's message is at 17:21:15, after this segment began, and names no road ('哪条快走哪条'), so RD-5 is not satisfied ('before you go'); RD-3(a) does not apply (no rider-named place) and RD-4(a) has no incident fact, so this unexempted segment counts under RD-1/RD-2.

The rider's 17:21:15 message ('随便你，哪条快走哪条，我赶时间') is a general route authorisation given before this long re-route began (~17:24, after the car turned back east near 1.320923,103.874471) and before the CTE/AYE corridor run, which leads to the destination. RD-5 covers a route chosen to get there, so this segment is exempt (no RD-4 incident fact exists to trigger RD-4 instead).

Same general authorisation: the final leg rejoins the quote corridor at 1.2916,103.8756 (~17:40) and runs on-route (Jalan Bukit Merah → Telok Blangah → Keppel → VivoCity) to the destination. RD-5 exempts the route chosen to reach the destination; no rider-named stop and no driver-level errand appears.
